BiblicalUsage: Shimrith is the Moabitess mother of Jehozabad, who with Jozachar slew King Joash. Her name stands beside Shimath's in the account of the murder.
TheologicalSignificance: A mother's name is given because the murder had a home behind it, and a Moabitess in the king's house is part of the story. I hold that Joash's end began when foreign wives came into the palace.
